author: reek
body: The codes are the record and the screen is the convenience, so the body carries every device, not the summary.

author: reek
body: Returns the y of the PS/2 row, so `top` for the codes is DERIVED from the last thing actually painted rather than hardcoded. The summary used to eat a fixed slab whatever the panel was, which is how a short mode ended up with 52 px of code space; a machine with fewer root ports now gives that space to the record instead.
